verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking controls are a fair question for an SDK and hosted facilitator like x402, but nothing in the evidence documents any telemetry opt-out or tracking disclosure. Automatic Bazaar listing after settlement is a discovery feature, not a telemetry control. No opt-out for it is documented either, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
